description: This Dart source file contains a function seedDefaults that initializes a database with default categories, budgets, and transaction data for a monthly expense tracking application. It ensures the database is seeded only when empty and inserts predefined categories, budgets, and a realistic batch of transactions spanning 30–60 days, including both income and expense entries.

methods.name: seedDefaults
methods.description: Seeds the database with default categories, budgets, and transactions if the relevant tables are empty, ensuring idempotency.

methods.name: _count
methods.description: Helper function to count the number of records in a specified table.

methods.name: _randomAmountInRange
methods.description: Generates a random monetary amount within a specified range, rounded to two decimal places.
